# Inside the Wǔxíng restoration: what the marks recover
Every name in this series was once flattened to fit a keyboard. **Wǔxíng** is what the evidence put back.

Wǔxíng has no divine biography, but its intellectual history is dramatic: it began as a description of natural processes, became a theory of state legitimacy, and ended as the diagnostic language of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The Hongfan chapter of the Shangshu presents the five phases as the first of the 'Nine Categories' revealed to Yu the Great.  Water, fire, wood, metal, and earth each have their nature: water soaks and descends, fire blazes and ascends, wood bends and straightens, metal yields and changes, earth sows and gathers.

That is the figure this file is about — and the temple now standing at its restored name.
## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Wǔxíng
- **ASCII form:** wuxing
- **Meaning:** "Five phases"
- **Domain of influence:** Five Elements, Change
- **Pantheon:** Chinese
- **Classification:** Tier 1
- **Original script:** 五行
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 263 of 271
## The Name Before the Marks

The name is attested as **五行**. On the evidence, it means "Five phases".

Strip **Wǔxíng** to *wuxing* and one piece of evidence vanishes:

- **i → í** — Stress on i: the stress position the ASCII form cannot show.

None of these marks is decoration. Each one is a fact about how the name was spoken, and each one is checkable against the scholarly record the temple cites.
## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Wǔxíng** lives at [/sites/wuxing/](/sites/wuxing/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/sites/wuxing/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/sites/wuxing/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/sites/wuxing/patterns/).

The restoration preserves more than the ASCII form can say — stress, length, or a letter the Latin keyboard lost — which places it in Tier-1: mechanically verifiable, information-rich.

Every flagship temple is hand-built to the same standard: the original script displayed with its provenance, the pronunciation reconstructed phoneme by phoneme, the sources named — because a restoration you cannot audit is just a spelling with confidence.
## The Archetype at Work

A temple is also a reading of what this figure *means* — and meanings have addresses in the modern world. The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) maps **Wǔxíng** to the industries its archetype genuinely resonates with, each match argued, weighted, and open to challenge:

- **Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine** — The five phases organize traditional Chinese medicine.
- **Architecture & Spatial Design** — The five phases guide material and directional harmony in design.
- **Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services** — Five-phase readings in astrology and wellness apps.

This is the part of the file that surprises people: a four-thousand-year-old name, mapping cleanly onto twenty-first-century trades. The patterns are not marketing — they are the same myths, read forward.
## In the Sacred Texts

The Chinese tradition is not a vibe; it is a library. The [Sacred Texts collection](/texts/) holds [Tao Te Ching](/texts/tao-te-ching/) — the primary sources the temple's scholarship is built on, free to read, cross-linked back to the names they mention. The temple is the argument; the texts are the evidence.
